From 05f0431bb90f2ee3657e7fc2678f11a1f9b778b7 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Jiri Pirko <jiri@nvidia.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Oct 2023 17:17:50 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] netlink: specs: devlink: add forgotten port function caps
 enum values

Add two enum values that the blamed commit omitted.

Fixes: f2f9dd164db0 ("netlink: specs: devlink: add the remaining command to generate complete split_ops")
Signed-off-by: Jiri Pirko <jiri@nvidia.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20231030161750.110420-1-jiri@resnulli.us
Signed-off-by: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>

diff --git a/net/devlink/netlink_gen.c b/net/devlink/netlink_gen.c
index 9cbae0169249..788dfdc498a9 100644
--- a/net/devlink/netlink_gen.c
+++ b/net/devlink/netlink_gen.c
@@ -15,7 +15,7 @@ const struct nla_policy devlink_dl_port_function_nl_policy[DEVLINK_PORT_FN_ATTR_
 	[DEVLINK_PORT_FUNCTION_ATTR_HW_ADDR] = { .type = NLA_BINARY, },
 	[DEVLINK_PORT_FN_ATTR_STATE] = NLA_POLICY_MAX(NLA_U8, 1),
 	[DEVLINK_PORT_FN_ATTR_OPSTATE] = NLA_POLICY_MAX(NLA_U8, 1),
-	[DEVLINK_PORT_FN_ATTR_CAPS] = NLA_POLICY_BITFIELD32(3),
+	[DEVLINK_PORT_FN_ATTR_CAPS] = NLA_POLICY_BITFIELD32(15),
 };
 
 const struct nla_policy devlink_dl_selftest_id_nl_policy[DEVLINK_ATTR_SELFTEST_ID_FLASH + 1] = {

diff --git a/Documentation/netlink/specs/devlink.yaml b/Documentation/netlink/specs/devlink.yaml
index c6ba4889575a..572d83a414d0 100644
--- a/Documentation/netlink/specs/devlink.yaml
+++ b/Documentation/netlink/specs/devlink.yaml
@@ -71,6 +71,10 @@ definitions:
         name: roce-bit
       -
         name: migratable-bit
+      -
+        name: ipsec-crypto-bit
+      -
+        name: ipsec-packet-bit
   -
     type: enum
     name: sb-threshold-type

diff --git a/tools/net/ynl/generated/devlink-user.c b/tools/net/ynl/generated/devlink-user.c
index 75b744b47986..bc5065bd99b2 100644
--- a/tools/net/ynl/generated/devlink-user.c
+++ b/tools/net/ynl/generated/devlink-user.c
@@ -121,6 +121,8 @@ const char *devlink_port_fn_opstate_str(enum devlink_port_fn_opstate value)
 static const char * const devlink_port_fn_attr_cap_strmap[] = {
 	[0] = "roce-bit",
 	[1] = "migratable-bit",
+	[2] = "ipsec-crypto-bit",
+	[3] = "ipsec-packet-bit",
 };
 
 const char *devlink_port_fn_attr_cap_str(enum devlink_port_fn_attr_cap value)
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `net/devlink/netlink_gen.c`**
   - The value for `DEVLINK_PORT_FN_ATTR_CAPS` in the `devlink_dl_port_function_nl_policy` array was changed from `NLA_POLICY_BITFIELD32(3)` to `NLA_POLICY_BITFIELD32(15)`. This modification updates the policy to accommodate additional capabilities.

2. **File: `Documentation/netlink/specs/devlink.yaml`**
   - Two new enum values were added under the capabilities section:
     - `ipsec-crypto-bit`
     - `ipsec-packet-bit`
   This addition expands the documentation to include the newly defined capabilities.

3. **File: `tools/net/ynl/generated/devlink-user.c`**
   - The string map for `devlink_port_fn_attr_cap_str` was updated to include the new capabilities:
     - Added `"ipsec-crypto-bit"` at index 2.
     - Added `"ipsec-packet-bit"` at index 3.
   This change ensures that the new capabilities are represented in the user-space string mapping.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications across the three files are interconnected as follows:

- The change in `netlink_gen.c` updates the policy for port function capabilities to reflect a broader range of options, specifically increasing the bitfield size to include new capabilities.
- The additions in `devlink.yaml` define the new capabilities (`ipsec-crypto-bit` and `ipsec-packet-bit`) that were omitted in a previous commit, ensuring that the documentation aligns with the updated policy.
- The updates in `devlink-user.c` provide the necessary user-space string representations for the newly defined capabilities, allowing applications to interpret and utilize these capabilities effectively.

Overall, these changes collectively enhance the devlink functionality by adding and documenting new capabilities while ensuring that both kernel and user-space components are synchronized.

 };


```c
[DEVLINK_PORT_FN_ATTR_CAPS] = NLA_POLICY_BITFIELD32(15),
```
Reason:
